scope: Single-Worker copying collector inhibition; other planned runtime globals remain unimplemented.
owner: CollectorOwner; base supplied by immutable owner layout, never a NIL-relative address.
access: Synchronous owner boundary. Host service operations 12/13 increment/decrement; final release performs pending collection. Return the signed nesting depth: negative means a collection is pending, positive means none is pending, zero means unlocked.
budget: The first inhibitor may relocate the heap to the memory tail while movement is still permitted; this reserves two current-capacity semispaces and can refuse with checked 6. Inhibited allocations grow in place and reserve a replacement inactive space. Abandoned spaces are not reclaimed in this Stage 1 owner. No external capability may grow memory while inhibition is active. This bounded owner does not claim native allocation capacity or timing equivalence.
failure_state: A failed first lock leaves Lisp heap, TCR, roots and inhibition cells unchanged; preparatory scratch growth may consume memory. On final-release collection failure the depth and pending cells are zero and the heap remains intact but uncollected. Collector/metadata failures are checked 11; growth limits/refusals are checked 6.
collector: All cells are raw unsigned words, excluded from root enumeration. Fresh instances start at depth zero and pending zero.
